svg.title: What run-all.sh runs side by side
svg.desc: Every supported Nextcloud version, from min-version to max-version, runs on SQLite with local storage and with the accessibility check. The newest version also runs on PostgreSQL, and on MariaDB with an S3 object store, without the accessibility check, which doesn't depend on them. The newest version that the last release supports as well upgrades an installation in use from that release to the package of the commit, on PostgreSQL and on MariaDB.
